name: Workflow Manager
description: Service-owned workflow engine: node model (agent source x output type), structured branch routing with Option A selection propagation, parallel scheduling with per-step/per-run timeouts, a live per-step run state (status/attempt/current action/per-sub-agent fan-out/agent trace) served to both the tools and the app, dry-run fixtures, EVENT-TRIGGERED runs (a workflow's `triggers` list subscribes it to 034 notification events; a dispatch starts a run with the event payload as its input and acks on run-start), EVENT EMISSION from an `event` node into BOS's event system plus event-type discovery, persistence to the real VFS, and 039-compliant service-declared tools (workflow_list/create/read/modify/run/status/cancel/delete/export/validate/run_list/run_get/event_types).

toolGroups.name: Workflows
toolGroups.description: Multi-step workflow automation: creating, reading, editing and validating workflows, running them, watching or cancelling a run, listing past runs, emitting BOS events from a workflow step, and discovering the event types a workflow can be triggered by.

port.description: HTTP port for the app-facing REST bridge (list/read/run/etc.) used by the Workflow Manager app. 0 lets the OS assign one automatically — never give this a fixed non-zero default.

host.description: Bind host for the REST bridge.

maxConcurrentSteps.description: Default cap on independent ready branches / Research-node fan-out that run concurrently for a workflow that does not set its own config.maxConcurrentSteps.
